gen-nixie-one-zilla-slab: Nostalgic and a little retro-tech, Nixie One draws hairline-steady curves with no pressure change, while Zilla Slab below it feels sturdy. Its bowls open broadly.
gen-orbitron-fs-hind: Hind reads with lowercase nearly as tall as its capitals, steady as a drawn string. Orbitron stretches its letters wide and shows off big open e shapes, while Hind keeps the text plain and sans-simple to follow.
gen-orbitron-fs-hoover: Refined is the first word for Hoover, a text serif with a generous entry into the e and short ascenders, under Orbitron. Orbitron spaces out; Hoover tightens up.
gen-orbitron-gf-courier-prime: Orbitron spreads its letters wide and precise. Courier Prime, a monospace with lowercase filling most of the height, would crowd the heading if the heading went small or the body went large.
gen-orbitron-gf-epunda-slab: Epunda Slab has a visibly gaping c and tall rounded lowercase. Orbitron above it is minimal and widely spaced, so the dignified text and the precise heading each hold their own.
gen-orbitron-instrument-sans: Crisp, spacious, a bit futuristic: Orbitron spreads its letters far apart, and Instrument Sans follows with c ends pointing apart like pincers and a plain sans stroke that never varies. Wide meets clean.
gen-patua-one-fs-erode: Erode brings a tall middle band, shallow ascenders and a gentle ebb and flow of weight, under a warm heading. Erode and Patua One share an easy approachability, moderate against low contrast.
gen-permanent-marker-archivo: Loud, scrawled and grungy, Permanent Marker keeps its curves nearly shut, while Archivo opens its curves outward beneath it. Archivo's commanding x-height holds up over a longer stretch.
gen-permanent-marker-fs-erode: Grunge up top, dignity below: Permanent Marker's slot-like openings give way to Erode, a text serif with broad apertures. And the hand-drawn heading makes the calm body feel more composed.
gen-playfair-display-fs-be-vietnam-pro: Literary Playfair Display pairs hairline strokes against fat ones, with a moderate lowercase height. Be Vietnam Pro, a plain sans with a high mean line, keeps going smoothly.
